pairs: Mary Magdalene went to the tomb early,
ad monumentum: et vidit lapidem sublatum a monumento.
and she saw that the stone had been rolled away from the tomb.
she ran and went to Simon Peter,
“They have taken the Lord away from the tomb,
and we do not know where they have laid him.”
Peter departed with the other disciple,
and they went to the tomb.
et ille alius discipulus præcucurrit citius Petro,
but the other disciple ran more quickly, ahead of Peter,
and so he arrived at the tomb first.
he saw the linen cloths lying there,
but he did not yet enter.
Venit ergo Simon Petrus sequens eum,
Then Simon Peter arrived, following him,
et introivit in monumentum, et vidit linteamina posita,
and he entered the tomb, and he saw the linen cloths lying there,
and the separate cloth which had been over his head,
not placed with the linen cloths,
sed separatim involutum in unum locum.
et ille discipulus qui venerat primus ad monumentum:
who had arrived first at the tomb,
For as yet they did not understand the Scripture,
quia oportebat eum a mortuis resurgere.
that it was necessary for him to rise again from the dead.
Abierunt ergo iterum discipuli ad semetipsos.
Then the disciples went away again, each by himself.
Maria autem stabat ad monumentum foris,
But Mary was standing outside the tomb,
she bowed down and gazed into the tomb.
et vidit duos angelos in albis sedentes,
And she saw two Angels in white,
sitting where the body of Jesus had been placed,
“Because they have taken away my Lord,
and I do not know where they have placed him.”
et non sciebat quia Jesus est.
but she did not know that it was Jesus.
Considering that it was the gardener,
tell me where you have placed him,
and I will take him away.”
And turning, she said to him,
nondum enim ascendi ad Patrem meum:
For I have not yet ascended to my Father.
Mary Magdalene went, announcing to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord,
Quia vidi Dominum, et hæc dixit mihi.
and these are the things that he said to me.”
Cum ergo sero esset die illo,
when it was late on the same day,
on the first of the Sabbaths,
ubi erant discipuli congregati propter metum Judæorum:
and the doors were closed where the disciples were gathered,
Jesus came and stood in their midst,
And when he had said this,
And the disciples were gladdened when they saw the Lord.
Therefore, he said to them again:
As the Father has sent me,
Those whose sins you shall forgive,
and those whose sins you shall retain,
Now Thomas, one of the twelve,
non erat cum eis quando venit Jesus.
was not with them when Jesus arrived.
the other disciples said to him,
Nisi videro in manibus ejus fixuram clavorum,
et mittam digitum meum in locum clavorum,
“Unless I will see in his hands the mark of the nails and place my finger into the place of the nails,
et mittam manum meam in latus ejus,
and place my hand into his side,
though the doors had been closed,
and he stood in their midst and said,
Infer digitum tuum huc, et vide manus meas,
“Look at my hands, and place your finger here;
and place it at my side.
And do not choose to be unbelieving,
Thomas responded and said to him,
Blessed are those who have not seen
Multa quidem et alia signa fecit Jesus in conspectu discipulorum suorum,
Jesus also accomplished many other signs in the sight of his disciples.
quæ non sunt scripta in libro hoc.
These have not been written in this book.
Hæc autem scripta sunt ut credatis,
But these things have been written,
quia Jesus est Christus Filius Dei:
so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ,
the Son of God, and so that,
in believing, you may have life in his name.
